items.title: nginx2root: Critical nginx RCE vulnerabilities [CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123634, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-113425]
items.summary: nginx2root is five critical nginx RCE vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-123007 in HTTP/2. Check if you’re affected and update to nginx 1.31.9 or 1.30.7.Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats
